review: I apologise for my English, which is not good. I teach catechism to thirty children in my parish and I came looking for anything they could sing that was not from 1985, and everything was English, which my ten-year-olds do not have. Then I found this. "Kochani Przed Słońcem" — loved before the sun. I did not know it was here. I have been on this website four months. My daughter is sixteen and she stopped coming to Mass and she was honest with me about why, which I respect and cannot answer. She listened to this in the car and did not turn it off. Five stars.
